messages:
marta: Quick thread — Helionix case story final runbook. Need: interview scheduled (customer in APAC/EU), one short quote about latency/cost savings, legal signoff on benchmark numbers, and a webinar slot (30–45m). Can we close by EOW?

sam: Thanks — can we get the interview before Thu? content needs 30m recorded + 15m buffer for followups. Will draft Qs.

raj: Webinar ask — tentatively Wed 11am PT? That hits ANZ + EU morning. How many seats do we expect? Might need marketing-run signup page.

marta: Proposed interview times I sent in calendar invite: Tue 08:00 GMT / Tue 20:00 AEST / Wed 16:00 PT. calendar-bot: Event created: "Helionix case interview (30m)" — invite sent to alex_cs, marta, sam, helionix-cs-contact.

alex_cs: Helionix prefers Tue 08:00 GMT. Confirmed. They asked if we can include the benchmark chart showing 3x throughput and -40% cost per token vs their previous ops.

sam: I'll draft the narrative. Quick question for marketing: do we want the benchmark numbers as absolute or relative? Customers prefer relative in quotes (easier to verify).

jules: Legal review: we need raw test logs and methodology before we can approve public benchmark claims. Also require Helionix written consent for publishing numbers and logo. Turnaround ~48 hrs after we get artifacts.

marta: Got it. Alex, can you ask Helionix for the runbook + logs and a short OK on the chart language? Suggested quote template below.

sam: Quote candidate (please tweak):
```
"Switching to Redwood Inference reduced our inference costs by ~40% and improved median latency by 3x, letting us ship real-time features to customers sooner."
```

raj: For webinar routing: capture form should route inbound leads to growth+sales queue with a webinar tag. Can we set an automated cadence: immediate drop to SDR + follow-up email with Helionix case excerpt?

marta: Yes — raj, can you add the webhook to our Drift/HubSpot flow? We need lead routing done before registration opens.

raj: On it. I'll scope the webhook and test events tomorrow.

jules: Also note: if the quote mentions specific % and latency numbers, we should add this clause to the legal release for Helionix to sign: "Customer consents to the public use of performance comparisons derived from their logs as submitted, and Redwood Inference may reproduce charts and summary statistics." Drafting now.

marta: Thanks — timeline recap:
- Today: calendar confirmed (Alex) & Sam drafts Qs + quote snippet.
- Tomorrow: Alex obtains logs + signed consent from Helionix.
- +48 hrs after logs: Jules approves benchmark language.
- Fri: Marketing finalizes blog draft & webinar registration page; Raj wires lead routing.

sam: I'll drop the interview prep doc here after Qs are ready and ping design for the chart. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: Helionix asked for a short pre-interview doc to share internal exec talking points. I'll attach after the call.

marta: Action items assigned. If anyone can't meet the timeline, flag here. Otherwise I'll start queuing the PR draft and webinar draft for review. :eyes:

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Helionix case interview" in 48 hours.
